summary: Viewed all four supplied PNGs, including the sheets' native 1x and nearest-neighbor 3x panels. The large verdigris cauldron, gold rim, three legs, handle-arms and red tassel are recognizable; broad upper-left highlights and the darker right plane give convincing volume. The raised handle, forward step, connected rightward punch and recovery read as one action. Forefeet share a ground line; the shorter rear leg reads in perspective. Skill preparation shows a gold-white core inside the opening, contact shows two attached fire columns, and recovery shows three attached embers. Poison uses narrowed eyes, a lowered arm and purple bubbles; stun uses slack arms and stars; sleep uses a low squat and closed eyes. These are distinguishable states rather than whole-body tints. Idle changes and state-pair changes are subtle at 1x. Intentional handle openings remain transparent, but the hit pose has a conspicuous notch in the left cauldron wall beneath its handle. The toppled dead pose remains identifiable. Recommendation concerns that local contour defect, not a user selection. Static pose previews cannot establish animation timing, dash/contact in actual battle, source authorship, or palette-index provenance; no geometry PASS is treated as visual approval.

issues.message: Repair the deep background-visible notch beneath the left handle: around x27-33, y59-65 the cauldron wall retreats to x34, then abruptly jumps left near y66, with a narrow open seam continuing toward y72. Redraw a continuous outlined wall from the underside of the rim into the belly, using the existing verdigris light/base/shadow clusters. Preserve the intentional opening inside the handle; do not fill the ring.
